title: Warehouse Lead
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Warehouse Lead to work in Columbus, OH
This position offers a strong benefits package, including health insurance, and paid time off.

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM (OT as needed)

Position Overview

The Material Services / Inventory Associate provides support to the Material Services organization by performing duties related to material accountability, inventory management, and operation of storerooms and storage yards. The role requires safe and efficient handling of materials, including heavy and irregularly shaped items, and may involve some local travel within a designated territory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Update, maintain, and organize inventory records, files, and material documentation.

  • Issue materials under proper authorization and maintain related records.

  • Check incoming materials for quantity, condition, and compliance; report irregularities.

  • Process and manage returned materials; sort usable vs. non-usable items.

  • Prepare materials for shipment or storage, including required shipping documentation.

  • Operate material handling equipment such as forklifts, telehandlers, hoists, cranes, and pallet jacks.

  • Assist in maintaining inventory accuracy through cycle counts and discrepancy adjustments.

  • Support supervisor and team members with storage organization and material relocation.

  • Follow all company safety policies and procedures.

  • Perform additional tasks as needed to support the Material Services team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in inventory control, material handling, warehousing, or a related field.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs (Excel, Word, Outlook) and basic computer skills.

  • Ability to operate motorized material handling equipment and road vehicles.

  • Physical capability to lift up to 70 pounds; successful completion of a Physical Ability Test (PAT) is required.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Motivated, dependable, team-oriented, respectful, and flexible.

  • Ability to work safely indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions.

  • Construction or heavy equipment experience preferred; training may be provided for specialized equipment.

Equipment Experience (Preferred)

  • Case 821 Wheel Loader / All-Terrain Forklift (up to 16,000 lbs.)

  • JLG Telehandler (7,000 – 12,000 lbs.)

  • Forklifts, pallet jacks, hoists, and other material handling tools

Work Environment

  • Sedentary to heavy lifting, including indoor warehouse and outdoor yard work.

  • Safety-focused, with Zero Harm as the #1 priority.

  • PPE provided (steel-toe boots required; side shields required if wearing glasses).

About Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS)
ITS is an international recruiting and staffing firm specializing in Engineering, Technical, and Professional positions. Founded in 1984 as a subsidiary of an engineering firm, ITS continues to be a strategic partner for job seekers and employers.

Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and vacation.

title: Supply Chain Business Analyst
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Supply Chain Business Analyst – Contract Administration in Columbus, OH. This role offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid holidays, and PTO.

SCHEDULE: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

JOB SUMMARY

Supports procurement and contract administration activities including contract data management, reporting, market research, spend analysis, and ServiceNow request tracking. Works with stakeholders to maintain accurate contract records, support procurement systems, and assist with reporting, analysis, and process improvements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support contract administration, reporting, and market research
  • Analyze spend data, pricing, and contract variances
  • Maintain contract records, bid sheets, and documentation
  • Track and manage ServiceNow procurement requests
  • Assist with procurement system support and troubleshooting
  • Enter and update contract rates and transactional data
  • Support reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communications
  • Ensure accuracy, compliance, and process adherence

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree + 3 years’ experience in Supply Chain/Procurement
    OR Associate’s degree + 5 years’ experience
    OR High School Diploma + 7 years’ experience
  • Experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, or related field
  • Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Word, Outlook)
  • Strong attention to detail and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and support multiple stakeholders
  • Sedentary work environment

title: Data Analyst
description:
ITS Technologies is seeking an Data Analyst to support Transmission Field Services by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and real-time quality of critical asset data used in energy delivery operations.

This role supports capital project closeout activities, asset validation, and ongoing data quality assurance for transmission infrastructure systems and records.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review engineering drawings (one-lines, schematics, BOMs, and manufacturer documentation) to identify and validate transmission assets for commissioning.
  • Support entry, updates, and maintenance of asset data within asset management systems.
  • Assist with creation and maintenance of asset hierarchies and attribute population.
  • Monitor data workflows and ensure timely completion of asset entry tasks.
  • Support commissioning activities including checklist coordination and asset in-service updates.
  • Perform data validation and assist in resolving discrepancies under supervision.
  • Support reporting and tracking of asset metrics using tools such as Power BI.
  • Collaborate with field teams and engineering groups to resolve data issues.
  • Assist with process improvements related to asset data management and commissioning workflows.

Essential Skills & Tools

  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Visio
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and engineering documentation
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple structured data tasks
  • Basic understanding of data entry, tracking systems, and reporting tools

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED with 2+ years of data/records management experience, OR
  • Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronic, Civil, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or related field with 1+ year of experience
  • Experience with data entry or technical recordkeeping preferred
  • Ability to work independently in a structured, compliance-driven environment

Preferred Experience

  • Utility, transmission, or engineering environment exposure
  • Experience with asset management or data tracking systems
  • Familiarity with construction or engineering drawings
  • Understanding of capital project or commissioning workflows

Additional Information

  • Entry-level technical role with training and development opportunities
  • Potential for conversion to full-time employment based on performance and business needs
  • Must be willing to work onsite full-time in a regulated utility environment

title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) is seeking a Senior Talent Acquisition
Specialist to join our team in Corpus Christi, TX. This role offers a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as paid time off and paid holidays.

Position Summary

The Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for full life cycle recruiting for corporate/exempt roles such as engineers and project managers: recruiting, screening and recommending placement of staff by using creative sourcing methods (internal and external). With this role's greater level of experience, the Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist can manage technical and non-technical exempt professional positions and management positions and other related responsibilities as assigned.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Partners with hiring manager and HR Business Partner to determine staffing needs. Screens resumes, interviews candidates (by phone or in person), administers appropriate assessments and reference/background checking, makes recommendations for hire (or not hire) and delivers employment offers for both exempt and nonexempt position openings within an assigned territory.
  • Serves as an expert for recruiting candidates within an assigned territory.
  • Uses traditional and nontraditional resources, such as career fairs, on-line job fairs, community network events, etc., to identify and attract quality candidates. Partners with Sourcing Specialist in order to bring a diverse slate of qualified candidates to the hiring manager. Manages internal transfer process, including screening, coordination of interviews with hiring manager, transfer offer letters, etc.
  • Follows up with candidates and hiring managers to obtain feedback regarding recruiting process. Develops and maintains an excellent relationship with internal and external clients to ensure achievement of staffing goals.
  • Communicates important employment information during delivery of employment offers (e.g., benefits, compensation, non-compete agreements). Responsible to ensure onboarding and new hire orientation processes occur.
  • Works with hiring managers to ensure compliance with all federal/state laws and regulations, including affirmative action plan compliance. Manages current candidate activity in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
  • Manages application/resume file and retention according to company policy.
  • Maintains memberships and affiliations with trade/professional organizations related to industry. Takes the lead in the development of one or more annual Affirmative Action Plans.
  • Suggests and helps implement on-going process improvements to ensure an effective, efficient and compliant recruiting process.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 years corporate experience in recruitment  an placement of applicants in professional and management level exempt positions including 3 years of knowledge and experience working with electronic applicant systems and internet recruiting sources.
  • Knowledge of human resources recruiting policies and procedures.
  • Valid driver’s license required
Competencies
  • Global & Cultural Awareness Relationship Management Consulting / Coaching.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
